noticias.titulo: TSMC or Nvidia: If I Could Only Own 1 for the Next 5 Years, It Would Be This 1.
noticias.resumo: The same concentration risk applies to many other tech companies.  Regardless of who dominates the AI race between the AI hyperscalers (Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta Platforms), they'll all rely on TSMC for manufacturing.  That puts TSMC in a very lucrative position for at least the next five years, but even after the AI frenzy, it'll remain a key piece in the supply chain for tons of other electronics.
